### ① Derived judgments

1. **`@object-ui/core` — `recordDelete.confirmCopy(deps, target)` added to the frozen `recordDelete` object; new exported types `RecordDeleteConfirmCopy` and `RecordDeleteConfirmTarget`** (reach the package root through `actions/index.ts` and the core barrel's `export * from './actions/index.js'`). RIGHT: additive. The one-record branch names the record through `getRecordDisplayName(deps.objectDef, record)` — the ADR-0079 resolver the record header already uses, so a declared `nameField` wins and an id-only row reads by the `Record #id` floor — and the body is the unchanged `recordDelete.confirmText`, so the ADR-0094 reset question for a package-owned permission set is preserved. The batch branch asks `objectActions.bulkDeleteConfirmTitle` with `count` and `label` and keeps the existing `console.objectView.bulkDeleteConfirm` body. `confirmText`'s signature and behaviour are unchanged. Pinned by the five new `recordDelete.confirmCopy` cases including the control that drops `objectDef` and reads the record key.
2. **`@object-ui/core` — `ConfirmationHandler` options gain `destructive?: boolean`.** RIGHT: optional, so every existing handler and every existing two-argument call still type-checks (`Type Check` success). The runner's own confirm step still hands the handler one argument; the diff adds no second dialect, it adds one optional field to the one options bag.
3. **`@object-ui/app-shell` — `useObjectActions` (exported from the package root): config gains `objectDef?: unknown`, `onConfirm` is retyped from the inline three-field shape to the published `ConfirmationHandler`, the result gains `deleteRecords(records)`.** RIGHT as a widening: the new `onConfirm` type accepts every handler the old one accepted. Behaviour change judged right: `deleteRecord` now asks ONCE through `onConfirm ?? window.confirm` with title, confirm label and `destructive: true`, then runs the runner's `delete` with no `confirmText`, so the runner's confirm step is not asked a second time; a cancel returns the runner's former `{ success: false, error: 'Action cancelled by user' }` (pinned). The dev's note that the hook's `loading` is false while the dialog is open is accepted — nothing in the repo reads it, and the runner's post-execution hook still owns the toasts through `recordDelete.run`.
4. **`@object-ui/app-shell` — `ConfirmDialogState.options` retyped to the published `ConfirmationHandler`'s own options parameter (read off the handler type with `Parameters`, not re-spelled); `ActionConfirmDialog` paints `buttonVariants({ variant: 'destructive' })` as a `className` when `options.destructive` is set.** RIGHT: the primitive `AlertDialogAction` composes `cn(buttonVariants(), className)`, so tailwind-merge resolves `bg-primary` to `bg-destructive`; without the flag the class is byte-identical. `packages/components/src/ui/alert-dialog.tsx` is untouched (No-Touch #7 held), matching the precedent of objectui#8978's renderer-side `actionVariant`. `buttonVariants` is reachable from the `@object-ui/components` barrel (`export * from './ui'`, `ui/index.ts` re-exports `./button`).
